Definition: flesh (as swelling out), as living or for food; generally food of any kind; figuratively, kindred by blood
BiblicalUsage: 1) flesh, food, body, near kin, near kinswoman; 1a) flesh; 1a1) as food; 1a2) for physical power (fig); 1b) flesh relation, blood relation; 1c) self
